summary.text: Rob Farnsworth is a Republican state senator from Hibbing, Minnesota, who represents District 7 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Kim McLaughlin.
He is a special education teacher and real estate agent.

paragraphs.text: Farnsworth was born in Chisholm, Minnesota, lives in Hibbing, and graduated from Chisholm High School in 1996. He earned a B.A. in history and social studies from the University of St. Thomas and an M.S. in special education from Minnesota State University, Mankato.
His career experience includes working as a teacher at Mounds View High School, as a special education teacher with the Hibbing school district, and as a real estate agent with Village Realty.
Farnsworth was elected to the Minnesota State Senate in 2022 and assumed office on January 3, 2023, succeeding Jen McEwen.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Education Finance, Higher Education Finance and Policy, and Transportation Finance and Policy.
